experiment: one-step ETT revision v2: stationary gate + zero-displacement atom; onset head with visible-history features (steps in hold, steps in band)
status: oracle-supervised engineering stage; disclosed revision after the Step 3a diagnosis (ett_rollout/SUMMARY.md)

changes.stationary_gate: P(stationary | s, a_b, a_q), label max |delta s| < 0.001; MLP (256, 256); BCE on all rows; at prediction delta = 0 when P > 0.5; motion regression trained on moving rows only
changes.onset_history: two features on the onset head: consecutive hold steps (advice max |a_b| < 0.05) and steps since band entry, each min(k, 100) / 100; computed from the path itself

unchanged: inputs, motion MLP, onset MLP, optimiser, budget, batches, cross-fitting, selection (+ 0.25 * stationary BCE)
gate_rule: G1 / G2 on moving held-out rows; G3-G6 as v1; G7 stationary gate AUROC and accuracy on held-out rows, and the atom's one-step xy error on stationary rows; any failure stops
